descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_return_zero_800063bc: Plan class method that always returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_nop_800063c4: Plan class method that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_return_zero_800063c8: Plan class method that always returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_ai_planner_stop: Stops the AI planner: idle becomes running, other active states fully reset while keeping team and registry.
descriptions.w3d_ai_planner_update: Advances the planner timer once per frame and runs planner steps while the timer is below its step size.
descriptions.w3d_ai_planner_destroy: Clears all planner state and destroys the queued AI command list.
descriptions.w3d_ai_planner_reset: Clears planner state, resets team selections and limits to defaults and puts the planner into its idle state.
descriptions.w3d_ai_planner_set_state: Sets the AI planner state number.
descriptions.w3d_ai_swap_plan_lists: Swaps the two current AI plan lists.
descriptions.w3d_ai_init_teams: Marks which of the 16 teams exist and are still alive, and clears each team's planner state.
descriptions.w3d_ai_push_plan_b: Appends a plan to the second plan list.
descriptions.w3d_ai_push_plan_a: Appends a plan to the first plan list and flags that new plans were added.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_get_name: Copies a plan's name, obtained through its type table, into a string.
descriptions.w3d_ai_vector_pop: Removes and returns the last element of a pointer list.
descriptions.w3d_ai_vector_push: Appends an element to a pointer list, growing its storage by about half when full.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_skip_turn_name: Returns the class name of the skip-turn plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_nop_80007760: Plan class method that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_return_zero_80007764: Plan class method that always returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_ai_check_skip_weapon: Checks whether weapon 49 (likely skip go) is available, ignoring the result.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_skip_turn: Queues the AI commands for skipping a turn, using weapon 49 when it is available.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_seed_name: Returns the class name of the seed plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_plan_nop_800077f0: Plan class method that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_ai_select_team: Forwards a team selection to the game's team handling.
descriptions.w3d_ai_begin_turn: Prepares the AI for a team's turn, resetting weapon state when the team changes, and refreshes the world map.
descriptions.w3d_ai_weapon_fired: Records that the selected weapon was used and decrements its remaining shots when a weapon is chosen.
descriptions.w3d_ai_select_weapon: Selects a weapon for the AI and reads its shot count from the weapon data, when allowed.
descriptions.w3d_ai_set_registry: Sets the object that receives newly queued AI commands.
descriptions.w3d_ai_weapon_available: Reports whether a weapon can be used now, from the inventory table or the current weapon's remaining shots.
